field.label: Enable Xray
field.help: Enable all configured Xray clients. Each client runs Xray on an internal loopback SOCKS5 listener and HEV provides its OPNsense tun(4) interface.

field.label: Enable Watchdog
field.help: Run an end-to-end health check for every enabled client once per minute. After three consecutive failures the watchdog restarts only that client, with a 10-minute per-client restart cooldown. Health checks and Gateway Health Sync continue even when automatic restart is disabled.
